answer: The cliff and unlock curve are enforced by the contract, and breaches are public. Tokens vest after a cliff and then unlock linearly, and the guard revokes unvested tokens on breach. A farm needs 260 separate vesting schedules, since one cliff cannot serve 260 identities. Honesty stays cheap and fakery is priced per head: the onyx signal is public, the glacier check is automatic, and 260 aliases cost 260 times what one real agent costs, with the ledge trail open to all.
